package parsers

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/parsers"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

func TestParseCourseFilters(t *testing.T) {
	validator := validator.New()

	tests := []struct {
		name      string
		query     url.Values
		wantError bool
		checkFunc func(*testing.T, filters.CourseFilters)
	}{
		{
			name:      "empty query",
			query:     url.Values{},
			wantError: false,
			checkFunc: func(t *testing.T, f filters.CourseFilters) {
				if f.ID != nil || f.Slug != nil || f.Status != nil || f.CatalogVisible != nil || f.Title != nil || f.TagID != nil || f.TagSlug != nil || f.CourseGroupID != nil || f.LevelID != nil || f.TrackID != nil {
					t.Error("all filters should be nil for empty query")
				}
				if f.Page == nil || *f.Page != filters.DefaultPage {
					t.Errorf("page should default to %d", filters.DefaultPage)
				}
				if f.Limit == nil || *f.Limit != filters.DefaultLimit {
					t.Errorf("limit should default to %d", filters.DefaultLimit)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "valid id filter",
			query: url.Values{
				"id": []string{uuid.New().String()},
			},
			wantError: false,
			checkFunc: func(t *testing.T, f filters.CourseFilters) {
				if f.ID == nil {
					t.Error("ID should be set")
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "invalid uuid in id",
			query: url.Values{
				"id": []string{"not-a-uuid"},
			},
			wantError: true,
		},
		{
			name: "valid slug filter",
			query: url.Values{
				"slug": []string{"go-basics"},
			},
			wantError: false,
			checkFunc: func(t *testing.T, f filters.CourseFilters) {
				if f.Slug == nil || *f.Slug != "go-basics" {
					t.Errorf("slug should be 'go-basics', got %v", f.Slug)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "slug too long",
			query: url.Values{
				"slug": []string{string(make([]byte, 256))}, // 256 bytes > 255 max
			},
			wantError: true,
		},
		{
			name: "valid status filter",
			query: url.Values{
				"status": []string{"1"},
			},
			wantError: false,
			checkFunc: func(t *testing.T, f filters.CourseFilters) {
				if f.Status == nil || *f.Status != 1 {
					t.Errorf("status should be 1, got %v", f.Status)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "negative status",
			query: url.Values{
				"status": []string{"-1"},
			},
			wantError: true,
		},
		{
			name: "unsupported status",
			query: url.Values{
				"status": []string{"3"},
			},
			wantError: true,
		},
		{
			name: "invalid status (not a number)",
			query: url.Values{
				"status": []string{"not-a-number"},
			},
			wantError: true,
		},
		{
			name: "valid catalog visibility filter",
			query: url.Values{
				"catalog_visible": []string{"false"},
			},
			wantError: false,
			checkFunc: func(t *testing.T, f filters.CourseFilters) {
				if f.CatalogVisible == nil || *f.CatalogVisible {
					t.Errorf("catalog_visible should be false, got %v", f.CatalogVisible)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "invalid catalog visibility filter",
			query: url.Values{
				"catalog_visible": []string{"hidden"},
			},
			wantError: true,
		},
		{
			name: "valid title filter",
			query: url.Values{
				"title": []string{"Go Course"},
			},
			wantError: false,
			checkFunc: func(t *testing.T, f filters.CourseFilters) {
				if f.Title == nil || *f.Title != "Go Course" {
					t.Errorf("title should be 'Go Course', got %v", f.Title)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "title too long",
			query: url.Values{
				"title": []string{string(make([]byte, 256))},
			},
			wantError: true,
		},
		{
			name: "valid pagination",
			query: url.Values{
				"page":  []string{"2"},
				"limit": []string{"50"},
			},
			wantError: false,
			checkFunc: func(t *testing.T, f filters.CourseFilters) {
				if f.Page == nil || *f.Page != 2 {
					t.Errorf("page should be 2, got %v", f.Page)
				}
				if f.Limit == nil || *f.Limit != 50 {
					t.Errorf("limit should be 50, got %v", f.Limit)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "invalid page",
			query: url.Values{
				"page": []string{"0"},
			},
			wantError: true,
		},
		{
			name: "invalid page negative",
			query: url.Values{
				"page": []string{"-1"},
			},
			wantError: true,
		},
		{
			name: "invalid page too large",
			query: url.Values{
				"page": []string{"101"},
			},
			wantError: true,
		},
		{
			name: "invalid limit too small",
			query: url.Values{
				"limit": []string{"9"},
			},
			wantError: true,
		},
		{
			name: "invalid limit too large",
			query: url.Values{
				"limit": []string{"101"},
			},
			wantError: true,
		},
		{
			name: "valid tag_id filter",
			query: url.Values{
				"tag_id": []string{"12"},
			},
			wantError: false,
			checkFunc: func(t *testing.T, f filters.CourseFilters) {
				if f.TagID == nil || *f.TagID != 12 {
					t.Errorf("TagID should be 12, got %v", f.TagID)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "invalid tag_id filter",
			query: url.Values{
				"tag_id": []string{"not-a-number"},
			},
			wantError: true,
		},
		{
			name: "valid tag_slug filter",
			query: url.Values{
				"tag_slug": []string{"frontend"},
			},
			wantError: false,
			checkFunc: func(t *testing.T, f filters.CourseFilters) {
				if f.TagSlug == nil || *f.TagSlug != "frontend" {
					t.Errorf("tag_slug should be 'frontend', got %v", f.TagSlug)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "valid catalog filters",
			query: url.Values{
				"track_id":        []string{uuid.New().String()},
				"level_id":        []string{uuid.New().String()},
				"course_group_id": []string{uuid.New().String()},
			},
			wantError: false,
			checkFunc: func(t *testing.T, f filters.CourseFilters) {
				if f.TrackID == nil || f.LevelID == nil || f.CourseGroupID == nil {
					t.Error("catalog filters should be set")
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "invalid catalog filter uuid",
			query: url.Values{
				"track_id": []string{"not-a-uuid"},
			},
			wantError: true,
		},
		{
			name: "all filters combined",
			query: url.Values{
				"id":              []string{uuid.New().String()},
				"slug":            []string{"go-basics"},
				"status":          []string{"1"},
				"catalog_visible": []string{"true"},
				"title":           []string{"Go Course"},
				"tag_id":          []string{"7"},
				"tag_slug":        []string{"frontend"},
				"track_id":        []string{uuid.New().String()},
				"level_id":        []string{uuid.New().String()},
				"course_group_id": []string{uuid.New().String()},
			},
			wantError: false,
			checkFunc: func(t *testing.T, f filters.CourseFilters) {
				if f.ID == nil || f.Slug == nil || f.Status == nil || f.CatalogVisible == nil || f.Title == nil || f.TagID == nil || f.TagSlug == nil || f.TrackID == nil || f.LevelID == nil || f.CourseGroupID == nil {
					t.Error("all filters should be set")
				}
			},
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			req := &http.Request{
				URL: &url.URL{
					RawQuery: tt.query.Encode(),
				},
			}

			result, err := parsers.ParseCourseFilters(req, validator)

			if tt.wantError {
				if err == nil {
					t.Error("expected error but got none")
				}
				return
			}

			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
			}

			if tt.checkFunc != nil {
				tt.checkFunc(t, result)
			}
		})
	}
}
